name: Shop Element for WooCommerce
author: Stacked Codes

sections.description:
Shop Element for Woocommerce adds a new Elementor element so that user can easily insert their woocommerce products anywhere in their elementor pages.

Features

  • Allows user to insert their woocommerce products anywhere in their elementor pages.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or greater
  • PHP version 7.0 or greater

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the ‘wp-content/plugins/” directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Once the plugin is installed, you can now go to your elementor page.
  4. Click New Element (the + sign button), go to Stackedcode Add Ons and find Woo Shop/Products.
